description: Live AIS vessel positions in the northern Baltic Sea and Finland only (Finnish AIS coverage, about 57–66°N, 17–35°E; not global): ships near a point (radius up to 1000 km, sorted by distance) or by MMSI/IMO/name/category, with name, IMO, type, speed, course, nav status, destination, ETA and size. Up to 30 vessels per call. Provided by Atlas Data (third-party seller); data from Fintraffic Digitraffic, CC BY 4.0; cached up to 3 min. Not for navigation. Price 0.02 USD per call via x402.

lat.description: Centre latitude (with lon), e.g. 60.15 for Helsinki

radiusKm.description: Search radius in km (default 20); the circle must reach the coverage area

name: maritime_vessels
